scope: Three bounded source-spec corrections from review-four-game-rules.md; not full-rulebook verification or runtime regeneration.

primary_rule.edition: Next Move English Azul base game
primary_rule.location: PDF pp. 2–5, Game Setup / Wall-tiling / Preparing the next round
primary_rule.checked_fact: Colored tiles begin in the opaque bag. Removed tiles go to the box lid. Lid tiles return to the bag only when it empties while factory displays are refilled.

implementation.source_change: bag / bag.scene now mean only the hidden bag; box-lid / box-lid.scene model the separate public discarded tile pool; preservation, correction and vision partitions include the new area.
implementation.recommendation: Preserve the bag and lid as separate physical stocks; record lid contents only when observed.

remaining_uncertainty: Gray-wall variant details, all scoring cases and actual photo recognition were not checked.

primary_rule.edition: Days of Wonder North America English ©2025
primary_rule.location: PDF pp. 2–4, Setting up the Game / The Game Turn / Draw Tickets / Game End
primary_rule.checked_fact: Each player starts with 45 trains. Spent train cards form a face-up discard to be reshuffled when the train deck empties. Kept destination tickets remain secret; 0–2 remaining trains at turn end start the last-turn cycle.

implementation.source_change: decks / decks.scene now exclude public discard; train-discard / train-discard.scene is common public; train-stock / train-stock.scene and existing remaining-trains bind to player-public stock. Owner-private hand / tickets stay unchanged.
implementation.recommendation: Keep public discard, private tickets, hidden draw decks and each player train stock in distinct saved physical locations.

remaining_uncertainty: Older North America printings and detailed route-legality/score adjudication were not checked.

primary_rule.location: PDF p. 2 (printed pp. 3–4), Spielvorbereitung / Einen Hinweis geben; PDF p. 1 (printed pp. 5–6), Wichtige Hinweise
primary_rule.checked_fact: The holder cannot see own card fronts while others can. A clue associates the indicated color/number with matching cards in a recipient hand. This edition permits hand rearrangement/reorientation.

implementation.source_change: hand.preserve is order_sensitive=true with steps to retain the current order, orientation and card-instance-to-clue association; hand remains own-hidden, not owner-private.
implementation.recommendation: Preserve each hand physically with backs toward its holder and link clues to current card instances rather than former slots.

remaining_uncertainty: Other language printings and variant clue rules were not checked.

validation.command: node --import tsx tools/game-specs/cli.ts validate <individual canonical spec>
validation.result: All three individual specs valid with zero issues; each retains its declared research-gap warning.

runtime_status: Generated packs and capture definitions remain at base commit; source profiles mark runtime_match=false.
